qrandomparity_n100.description: QRandomParity benchmark at n=100 from Table 1. Lower median runtime is better, while still solving all instances within the timeout.

median_runtime_s.description: Median runtime over solved instances — primary metric, measures typical-case performance.

instances_solved.description: Count of instances solved within timeout — correctness constraint, rewards reliability.

mean_runtime_s.description: Mean runtime over solved instances — triangulates median by upweighting outlier-sensitive mean.

p90_runtime_s.description: 90th percentile capped runtime over the fixed slice, treating unsolved or over-timeout instances as the timeout — anti-shortcut metric, penalizes tail latency and unsolvable cases.
